hero.title: Answer support questions before they reach your team.
hero.body: Order status, delivery, returns and policy questions get an answer straight away. When a customer needs a person, the agent hands over with the full conversation.
hero.reassurance: Answers from your information. Order checks from your store. A person when needed.

seo.title: AI support agent for WhatsApp and web chat | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer order, delivery and policy questions automatically, create tickets and hand over to your team with the full conversation.

walkthrough.title: One support conversation, start to finish.
walkthrough.intro: What happens when a customer gets in touch about an order.

steps.label: Find the order
steps.agent: Your order 2087 has shipped and is out for delivery today.
steps.note: The agent checks the order in your store and shipping tool.

steps.label: Answer the policy question
steps.customer: If it does not fit, can I return it?
steps.agent: Yes, unworn items can be returned within the period on our returns page. Shall I share the steps?
steps.note: Answers come from your own policy pages.

steps.label: Raise a ticket
steps.customer: Actually the last one arrived damaged.
steps.agent: Sorry about that. Could you share a photo? I will open a ticket for our team.
steps.note: The ticket skill collects the fields you require, including photos.

steps.label: Hand over to a person
steps.agent: Of course. I have passed this to our team and someone will join shortly.
steps.note: Your team claims the conversation in the shared inbox.

capabilities.title: What your support agent can do.
capabilities.intro: Clear the repeat questions and keep your team for the rest.

items.title: Check orders and deliveries
items.body: Look up orders in Shopify or WooCommerce and shipments with five Indian carriers.

items.title: Answer from your help content
items.body: Use your website, FAQs and documents to answer in plain language.

items.title: Create tickets
items.body: Collect order numbers, photos and other required fields, then notify the right people.

items.title: Hand over cleanly
items.body: Set a wait time, a fallback message and email alerts for handoffs.

items.title: Answer missed calls on WhatsApp
items.body: Reply to missed WhatsApp calls with a message so the customer is not left waiting.

tools.title: Works with your support tools.
tools.intro: Connect your store, carriers and helpdesk.

quote.excerpt: The order-status questions have almost disappeared from our support queue. We still get the odd one, but it’s nowhere near what it used to be.
quote.attribution: Maya Patel | Head of E-commerce | North & Pine

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Order tracking and human handoff start from the Starter plan.
The agent shares the status your store and carriers report. It cannot change a delivery.

faq.title: Questions about the AI support agent.

items.q: What if the agent does not know the answer?
items.a: It says so and passes the conversation to your team, rather than guessing.

items.q: Can it create tickets in Zendesk?
items.a: Connect Zendesk to send tickets there, or keep them in the Steps AI CRM.

cta.title: See the AI support agent with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
